summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K to report weekly progress under its share buyback program announced 30 Oct 2025, with a EUR 30 million mandate to an independent intermediary. During 27 Apr–1 May 2026, it repurchased 27,493 shares at avg EUR 4.54 each (total EUR 124,826). Since program start (26 Jan 2026), 629,080 shares have been bought back for EUR 2,832,788, representing 1.1% of total shares outstanding. The filing is a standard ongoing update to a board-authorized buyback program. There are no deal terms, premium, or changes in control. The program reduces share count and returns capital to shareholders. No structural implications or regulatory clock are triggered; watch for continued execution pace.
